translations.web: Behold, to Yahweh your God belongs heaven, the heaven of heavens, and the earth, with all that is therein.
translations.bsb: Behold, to the LORD your God belong the heavens, even the highest heavens, and the earth and everything in it.
translations.kjv: Behold, the heaven and the heaven of heavens is the LORD'S thy God, the earth
translations.asv: Behold, unto Jehovah thy God belongeth heaven and the heaven of heavens, the earth, with all that is therein.
